articles.title: 12th National Handloom Day — President Murmu at Rashtrapati Bhavan
articles.title_hi: 12वां राष्ट्रीय हथकरघा दिवस — राष्ट्रपति मुर्मू राष्ट्रपति भवन में
articles.summary: President Droupadi Murmu presided over the 12th National Handloom Day at Rashtrapati Bhavan Cultural Centre on 7 August 2026.
articles.summary_hi: राष्ट्रपति द्रौपदी मुर्मू ने 7 अगस्त 2026 को राष्ट्रपति भवन सांस्कृतिक केंद्र में 12वां राष्ट्रीय हथकरघा दिवस की अध्यक्षता की।
articles.content:
National Handloom Day is observed annually on 7 August to commemorate the Swadeshi Movement of 1905. On 7 August 2026, President Droupadi Murmu addressed the 12th edition at the Rashtrapati Bhavan Cultural Centre (RBCC), New Delhi.

She conferred 22 awards — 3 Sant Kabir Handloom Awards and 19 National Handloom Awards for 2025. Four commemorative postage stamps on handloom traditions were released.

Over 35 lakh people work in India's handloom sector; about 25 lakh are women.

For IB ACIO: 7 August, 12th edition 2026, President Murmu, RBCC, Swadeshi Movement 1905.
articles.content_hi:
7 अगस्त — National Handloom Day। 12th edition 2026, President Murmu, RBCC। Swadeshi Movement 1905। 22 awards, 4 stamps।

IB ACIO: 7 Aug, 1905 Swadeshi — याद रखें।
articles.question: National Handloom Day commemorates which movement?
articles.question_hi: राष्ट्रीय हथकरघा दिवस किस आंदोलन की स्मृति में?
articles.explanation: National Handloom Day marks the Swadeshi Movement of 1905.
articles.explanation_hi: राष्ट्रीय हथकरघा दिवस 1905 स्वदेशी आंदोलन की स्मृति में है।

articles.title: Sant Kabir and National Handloom Awards 2025 Conferred
articles.title_hi: सant कबीर और राष्ट्रीय हथकरघा पुरस्कार 2025 प्रदान
articles.summary: President Murmu honoured 22 artisans including Ram Meher (Odisha), Runima Chetiya Choudhury (Assam) and Shah Muhammad Ansari (UP).
articles.summary_hi: राष्ट्रपति मुर्मू ने Ram Meher (Odisha), Runima Chetiya Choudhury (Assam) और Shah Muhammad Ansari (UP) सहित 22 कारीगरों को सम्मानित किया।
articles.content:
On National Handloom Day 2026, President Murmu presented Sant Kabir Handloom Awards and National Handloom Awards for 2025 to 22 weavers, designers, cooperatives and entrepreneurs.

Sant Kabir awardees included Ram Meher (Bichitpar Khadi Saree, Odisha), Runima Chetiya Choudhury (Muga Silk Saree, Assam) and Shah Muhammad Ansari (Zarbaft Awadh Jamdhani, UP).

For IB ACIO: 3 Sant Kabir + 19 National Handloom Awards, 2025 batch conferred in 2026.
articles.content_hi:
Sant Kabir Awards: Ram Meher (Odisha), Runima Chetiya (Assam), Shah Muhammad Ansari (UP)। Total 22 awards (2025 batch)।

IB ACIO: Sant Kabir Handloom Award — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: 7 अगस्त 2026 को कुल कितने handloom awards प्रदान किए गए?
articles.explanation: A total of 22 awards (3 Sant Kabir + 19 National Handloom) were conferred.
articles.explanation_hi: कुल 22 awards (3 Sant Kabir + 19 National Handloom) प्रदान किए गए।

articles.title: Handloom Sector — 35 Lakh Workers, 25 Lakh Women
articles.title_hi: हथकरघा क्षेत्र — 35 लाख कार्यकर्ता, 25 लाख महिलाएं
articles.summary: President Murmu noted handloom preserves heritage while promoting employment and women's empowerment.
articles.summary_hi: राष्ट्रपति मुर्मू ने कहा हथकरघा विरासत संरक्षण के साथ रोजगार और महिला सशक्तिकरण को बढ़ावा देता है।
articles.content:
India's handloom sector employs more than 35 lakh people, of whom about 25 lakh are women, as highlighted on National Handloom Day 2026.

The sector is linked to India's freedom struggle and self-reliance vision. Handloom exports and GI-tagged products support rural livelihoods.

For IB ACIO: 35 lakh workers, 25 lakh women, Ministry of Textiles oversight.
articles.content_hi:
Handloom: 35 lakh workers, 25 lakh women। Ministry of Textiles। GI tags, exports।

IB ACIO: 35 lakh — याद रखें।

articles.question_hi: भारत के handloom sector में लगभग कितनी महिलाएं engaged हैं?
articles.explanation: About 25 lakh women work in the handloom sector.
articles.explanation_hi: लगभग 25 lakh महिलाएं handloom sector में हैं।

articles.summary_hi: India Post ने National Handloom Day 2026 पर विविध handloom परंपराओं पर चार stamps जारी किए।

Stamps highlight regional weaving styles and artisan craftsmanship.

articles.title_hi: Monsoon Session जारी — NEET पर Opposition protests
articles.summary: Parliament's Monsoon Session (20 July–13 August) saw disruptions over alleged NEET paper leak and exam reforms.
articles.summary_hi: Parliament Monsoon Session (20 July–13 August) में alleged NEET paper leak और exam reforms पर disruptions।
articles.content:

Lok Sabha productivity was about 19%; Rajya Sabha about 39%. Despite disruptions, 12 bills were passed.

articles.title: Immigration and Foreigners Bill 2026 — MHA Consolidates Four Laws
articles.title_hi: Immigration and Foreigners Bill 2026 — MHA ने चार कानून consolidate किए
articles.summary: Lok Sabha passed Bill consolidating Foreigners Act 1946 and three other colonial-era immigration laws.
articles.summary_hi: Lोकसभा ने Foreigners Act 1946 और तीन अन्य colonial-era immigration laws consolidate करने वाला Bill पारित किया।
articles.content:
The Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2026 consolidates the Foreigners Act 1946, Passport (Entry into India) Act 1920, Registration of Foreigners Act 1939, and Immigration (Carriers' Liability) Act 2000.

Administered by MHA through Bureau of Immigration. Introduces digital immigration records.

For IB ACIO: MHA, 4 laws consolidated, Bureau of Immigration.
articles.content_hi:
Immigration Bill 2026: MHA, Bureau of Immigration। 4 laws — Foreigners Act 1946, Passport Entry 1920, Registration 1939, Carriers' Liability 2000।

IB ACIO: MHA — याद रखें।
articles.question: The Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2026 is administered by:
articles.question_hi: Immigration and Foreigners Bill, 2026 किसके द्वारा administered है?
articles.explanation: The Bill falls under MHA via Bureau of Immigration.
articles.explanation_hi: Bill MHA के अधीन Bureau of Immigration के माध्यम से है।

articles.title: Handloom and Swadeshi — Link to Freedom Struggle
articles.title_hi: हथकरघा और स्वदेशी — स्वतंत्रता संग्राम से जुड़ाव
articles.summary: President Murmu said handloom reflects self-reliance vision linked to India's freedom movement.
articles.summary_hi: राष्ट्रपति मुर्मू ने कहा handloom स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन से जुड़े आत्मनिर्भरता vision को दर्शाता है।
articles.content:
Handloom was central to the Swadeshi Movement (1905) boycotting foreign goods. Mahatma Gandhi promoted khadi as a symbol of self-reliance.

National Handloom Day (7 August) celebrates this legacy. Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) continues the tradition.

For IB ACIO: Swadeshi 1905, khadi, KVIC, Gandhi.
articles.content_hi:
Swadeshi 1905, khadi, KVIC, Gandhi। Handloom = freedom struggle symbol।

IB ACIO: 1905 Swadeshi — याद रखें।
articles.question: Khadi promotion is associated with which commission?
articles.question_hi: Khadi promotion किस commission से जुड़ा है?
articles.explanation: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) promotes khadi.
articles.explanation_hi: KVIC khadi को promote करता है।

articles.title: GI Tags and Handloom Heritage Protection
articles.title_hi: GI Tags और Handloom Heritage संरक्षण
articles.summary: Geographical Indication tags protect regional handloom products like Banarasi silk and Pochampally Ikat.
articles.summary_hi: GI tags Banarasi silk और Pochampally Ikat जैसे regional handloom products की रक्षा करते हैं।
articles.content:
Geographical Indication (GI) tags under the Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999 protect authentic regional handloom products.

Examples: Banarasi Brocade, Kanchipuram Silk, Muga Silk (Assam), Pochampally Ikat (Telangana).

For IB ACIO: GI Act 1999, handloom examples, WIPO link.
articles.content_hi:
GI Act 1999। Examples: Banarasi, Kanchipuram, Muga, Pochampally।

IB ACIO: GI Act 1999 — याद रखें।
articles.question: GI tags in India are governed by an Act of:
articles.question_hi: India में GI tags किस Act से governed हैं?
articles.explanation: The Geographical Indications of Goods Act, 1999 governs GI tags.
articles.explanation_hi: Geographical Indications of Goods Act, 1999 GI tags govern करता है।

articles.title: Ministry of Textiles — Handloom Policy Overview
articles.summary: Ministry of Textiles implements National Handloom Development Programme and Hathkargha Samvardhan Sahayata.
articles.summary_hi: वस्त्र मंत्रालय National Handloom Development Programme और Hathkargha Samvardhan Sahayata implement करता है।
articles.content:
The Ministry of Textiles oversees India's handloom sector through schemes like National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP), Comprehensive Handloom Cluster Development Scheme, and Hathkargha Samvardhan Sahayata for looms and accessories.

Handloom Export Promotion Council supports overseas markets.

For IB ACIO: Ministry of Textiles, NHDP, handloom schemes.
articles.content_hi:
Ministry of Textiles: NHDP, cluster development, Hathkargha Samvardhan Sahayata।

IB ACIO: Ministry of Textiles — याद रखें।
articles.question: India's handloom sector primarily falls under:
articles.question_hi: India का handloom sector मुख्यतः किसके अधीन है?
articles.explanation: The Ministry of Textiles oversees the handloom sector.
articles.explanation_hi: वस्त्र मंत्रालय handloom sector की देखरेख करता है।

articles.title: India-Canada Diplomatic Ties — High Commissioner Ajay Bisaria
articles.title_hi: India-Canada Diplomatic Ties — High Commissioner Ajay Bisaria
articles.summary: India appointed Ajay Bisaria as High Commissioner to Canada as bilateral ties stabilised after 2023-24 freeze.
articles.summary_hi: 2023-24 freeze के बाद bilateral ties stabilise होने पर India ने Ajay Bisaria को Canada High Commissioner नियुक्त किया।
articles.content:
India appointed senior diplomat Ajay Bisaria as High Commissioner to Canada in August 2026 as bilateral relations improved after the 2023-24 diplomatic row over Khalistani separatism allegations.

Canadian FM Anita Anand visited India for trade and diaspora talks.

For IB ACIO: Ajay Bisaria, Canada HC, Anita Anand visit Aug 2026.
articles.content_hi:
Ajay Bisaria — HC to Canada (Aug 2026)। Anita Anand visit। Post-2023-24 diplomatic freeze।

articles.question_hi: Ajay Bisaria को India का High Commissioner कहाँ नियुक्त किया गया?
